citations.title: BNP Paribas Gets ECB Query Over Succession Plan for CEO Bonnafe - Bloomberg

sentences.text: In the past year BNP Paribas, still led by Jean-Laurent Bonnafe, has reshuffled its Executive Committee: Charlotte Dennery became chair of BNP Paribas Personal Finance on 1 January 2026, with Gilles Zeitoun named its CEO and joining the group Executive Committee, and Sandro Pierri, CEO of BNP Paribas Asset Management, joined the Executive Committee on 30 March 2026, reporting to deputy COO Renaud Dumora.
Beatrice Belorgey retired from heading BNP Paribas in Luxembourg, succeeded by Nicolas Otton from 1 January 2026.

sentences.quote: The ECB has sought information on the process as part of its regular annual exercise to set BNP Paribas' capital requirements, according to people familiar with the matter. The query was also about filling other top leadership roles including the chairmanship, currently held by Jean Lemierre
sentences.text: In July 2026 the ECB asked the bank, as part of its annual capital-requirements review, to set out its transition plans for replacing Bonnafe and for other top roles including chairman Jean Lemierre.

citations.title: BNP Paribas stock prepares for 2030 plan after CET1 reaches 13 percent

sentences.text: BNP Paribas targets a return on tangible equity above 13% in 2028 with a cost-income ratio below 56% and net income growth of more than 10% a year from 2025 to 2028.
Management reaffirmed these 2028 objectives alongside a 12% ROTE goal for 2026.
Capital is ahead of plan: the CET1 ratio reached the 13% target in the second quarter of 2026, eighteen months early, and excess capital will be considered for distribution annually.
Shareholder returns run at a minimum 60% payout for 2026, with a floor of 60% expected from 2027.
Profitability improvement rests on named franchise plans for Personal Finance, French and Belgian retail, Bank Polska and the AXA IM asset-management integration.
